author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
In an Agent loop, the state of the repo is broken until the loop is completed.

If someone accidently steps into the loop, they will be experiencing a broken code base.

You have to build your infrastructure to segregate humans from the broken code base when AI is looping.

In the good old CD/CI, we call it the development staging or production staging, but we the loop actually runs inside the development staging, we need further partitioning of the dev stage.
